create_skill_policy: create a SkillPolicy instance that manages skill execution with configurable action space and batch size
implement_internal_act: implement the _internal_act method in a SkillPolicy subclass to define custom skill action logic
apply_postcondition: apply PDDL postconditions to modify actions based on skill termination and entity arguments
check_skill_termination: check if a skill should terminate by evaluating observations and step count against max_skill_steps
keep_holding_state: keep the robot gripper holding state unchanged during navigation skills that should not interact with objects
